svg.title: evalopt-graph · acceptance policy kernel: Do the gates, claims and evidence satisfy the acceptance policy?
svg.desc: A zero-dependency kernel turns host-supplied records into one replayable decision with stable reason codes. Evidence card: POLICY · required_gates = ("tests", "lint"). tests PASS · lint PASS → ACCEPTED ('policy_satisfied',); tests FAIL · lint PASS → FAILED ('required_gate_failed:tests',); gates pass · tests_weakened → BLOCKED ('tests_weakened',). README example · decisions are content-addressed; replay() re-checks them later.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
